subject: english
question:
Identify the option that rectifies the error in the given sentence.

In the future, people are not going to physical stores as much as they do now.

options.text: In the future, people were not going to physical stores as much as they do now.
In the future, people are not gone to physical stores as much as they do now.
In the future, people should not go to physical stores as much as they do now.
In the future, people will not go to physical stores as much as they do now.

solution:
The correct option is: '**In the future, people will not go to physical stores as much as they do now'**. 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• In the sentence it is already given that the work is done in the **future**, so the tense used should be future tense.
 
• In the future tense:

 are and is not considered instead of that use '**will'.**

 
• For example:

 
• I am not going to the school on next weekend.(incorrect)
 
• I will not go to school on next weekend.(correct)

Therefore, the correct sentence should be: *In the future, people **will not go **to physical stores as much as they do now*. 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The **past tense** is used when we talk about the real situation which has already been done like

** example-**He **had** done his homework.

 
• The **future tense** is used when the event is going to happen after some time or after few days ,months or years

** example- **He **will** complete his homework after 1 week.
